say:1:1441107001:1.text: Magister, Chippy didn't know Brimstone Village was so high up! We actually need to take a lift to get there!
say:1:1441107001:1.source_cn: 主人，满满没想到，深岩村竟然在这么高的地方！进出都得坐...
say:1:1441107001:1.male: Magister, Chippy didn't know Brimstone Village was so high up! We actually need to take a lift to get there!
say:1:1441107001:1.female: Magister, Chippy didn't know Brimstone Village was so high up! We actually need to take a lift to get there!

say:2:1441107002:1.text: It's the only way to get into the village...
say:2:1441107002:1.source_cn: 矮人的升降机是进入深岩村的唯一方式……

say:3:1441107003:1.text: The chief claimed it was for convenience, but I suspect they are hiding something.
say:3:1441107003:1.source_cn: 虽然那个村长说是为了便利，总有种他们在防备着什么的感觉。

say:4:1441107004:1.text: Whatever they are plotting, they won't succeed with <style="stress"><player_name></style> around!
